canonical_name: Tierra 6.02 -- Thomas S. Ray (1991-1998), mirror of the life.ou.edu source
lineage: Ray 1991 'An approach to the synthesis of life' (Artificial Life II) -> Tierra releases through 6.02 (1998); Avida (1993-) is the instrumentation-rich descendant lineage
version: acisternino/tierra master @ 195c2eb84d91a1938faabad38e24b9b47d0e262c (mirror of Tierra v6.02 from life.ou.edu; two further mirrors pinned in SOURCES_2026-09-17.json)

license.spdx: custom non-commercial (Ray, tierra/license.h 1995): free copying and distribution without fees; no commercial use; modified versions must document changes and notify the principal author; notice must not be removed
license.status: read 2026-09-17; preservation and research permitted; NOT OSI

compiler_or_interpreter: gcc (era: SunOS/Linux 1990s; build in fossil-c bookworm to be measured)
entry_points: tierra/genebank.h / rambank.c / diskbank.c (the gene bank: what earns a permanent name and is saved as a .gen)

example.input: soup_in (soup size, mutation rates, gene bank settings) + the ancestor 0080aaa
example.output: gb/ directory of .gen genotypes (the gene bank); tierra.log

environment.image: prometheus-fossil-c:bookworm (to be measured; not built on M3)

human_capability_summary.built_to: evolve self-replicating machine-code creatures in a shared memory 'soup' under CPU-time and space competition
human_capability_summary.pressure: study open-ended evolution with a substrate simple enough to run on 1990s hardware and rich enough for parasitism to arise
human_capability_summary.success_means: the gene bank filling with novel, persistent genotypes; parasites, hyperparasites and social behaviour observed

known_human_problem_solved: a minimal executable ecology in which evolution invents ecological relations unprogrammed by the author
human_environmental_pressure: disk and compute scarcity: only genotypes that earn a name are banked (the admission rule Nyx will cut)
human_failure_condition: the soup dies out or fills with the ancestor only; the bank records nothing new
behavioral_entry_point: run to a fixed number of instructions and diff gb/ against the ancestor; vary the admission threshold in soup_in

native_deps: X11 for the optional GUI only

preservation.note: status is the worse of body_status and the recipe axis; a matching tree hash alone never implies completeness.
